xmldoc.short_description: Add a shared title to a graphics layout.

param_input_item.param_description: A tiled layout or axes graphics object.

param_output_item.param_description: A graphics object for the shared title.

description.p: sgtitle adds a shared title to the current tiled layout when one exists. Otherwise, it adds a shared title above the subplot axes in the current figure.

example_item.example_item_description: Shared title for a subplot grid.
example_item.example_item_data: f = figure(); subplot(2, 2, 1) title('First Subplot') subplot(2, 2, 2) title('Second Subplot') subplot(2, 2, 3) title('Third Subplot') subplot(2, 2, 4) title('Fourth Subplot') sgtitle('Subplot Grid Title')

example_item.example_item_description: Shared title for a tiled layout.
